# Coin Theory

> Money explained simply with animated stories and real, sourced data (FRED, BLS, Federal Reserve, Yahoo Finance). YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@cointheoryhq

## Calculators
- [Inflation calculator](https://coin-theory-money.vercel.app/calculators/inflation.html): what money from any year since 1947 is worth today (CPI-U).
- [S&P 500 "what if I invested" calculator](https://coin-theory-money.vercel.app/calculators/sp500.html): growth of a one-time investment since 1988, dividends reinvested.
